name: ASCTrendND
summary: This EA trades based on ASCTrend indicator signals, filtered by NRTR and TrendStrength indicators to confirm trend direction. It uses ASCTrend signal values as stop loss levels and manages open positions via a trailing stop mechanism with no take profit target.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ASCTrend指标信号进行交易，并通过NRTR和TrendStrength指标过滤确认趋势方向。它使用ASCTrend信号值作为止损水平，通过追踪止损管理持仓，不设止盈目标。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是ASCTrend指标产生主交易信号，当卖出信号缓冲区或买入信号缓冲区出现有效值时触发入场。入场信号需经过两层过滤：NRTR指标确认趋势方向（买入需NRTR上升趋势确认，卖出需NRTR下降趋势确认），TrendStrength指标进一步验证趋势强度。出场完全依赖追踪止损机制，不设固定止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数，资金管理模块声明未实现（lotsMode=0）。止损基于ASCTrend信号值，并受限于经纪商的止损水平要求。仅在新K线形成时检查信号，避免重复交易。同时只持有一个仓位，通过Magic Number识别。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core relies on the ASCTrend indicator to generate primary trade signals, triggered when valid values appear in the sell or buy signal buffers. Entry signals must pass through two filter layers: the NRTR indicator confirms trend direction (buys require NRTR uptrend confirmation, sells require NRTR downtrend confirmation), and the TrendStrength indicator further validates trend strength. Exit relies entirely on a trailing stop mechanism with no fixed take profit target. Position sizing uses fixed lots, as the money management module is explicitly declared unimplemented (lotsMode=0). Stop loss is based on ASCTrend signal values, constrained by the broker's stop level requirements. Signals are checked only on new bar formation to prevent repeated trades. Only one position is held at a time, identified by Magic Number.

parameters.name: Magic
parameters.description: 魔术号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for identifying EA orders

parameters.name: ascUseAsStoploss
parameters.description: 是否使用ASCTrend信号值作为止损
parameters.description_en: Use ASCTrend signal value as stop loss

pros: 多层过滤机制（ASCTrend+NRTR+TrendStrength）减少虚假信号
仅在新K线形成时检查信号，避免tick级别过度交易
使用Magic Number隔离仓位，避免与其他EA冲突
止损水平受经纪商止损距离约束，降低被拒单风险
代码结构清晰，信号检查、过滤、执行分离
pros_en: Signal check only on new bar formation avoids tick-level overtrading
Magic Number isolates positions preventing conflicts with other EAs
Stop loss constrained by broker stop level requirements reduces rejected orders
Clean code architecture with separated signal checking, filtering, and execution
cons: 资金管理模块未实现，仅支持固定手数，缺乏风险控制灵活性
无止盈设置，完全依赖追踪止损出场，可能错过快速反转前的利润锁定
OnDeinit中注释掉了NRTR和TrendStrength的IndicatorRelease调用，存在资源泄漏
Breakeven和ProfitLock功能标记为未测试，代码中存在但不可配置
异步交易模式(SetAsyncMode=true)但缺乏完整的事务确认和重试机制
CheckPositionExist仅检查单品种单仓位，无法处理多仓位场景
cons_en: Money management module unimplemented, only fixed lots supported, lacking risk control flexibility
No take profit, exit relies entirely on trailing stop which may miss profit locking before quick reversals
NRTR and TrendStrength IndicatorRelease calls are commented out in OnDeinit, causing resource leaks
Breakeven and ProfitLock features marked as untested, present in code but not configurable via inputs
Async trading mode enabled without complete transaction confirmation and retry mechanisms
CheckPositionExist only checks single symbol single position, cannot handle multi-position scenarios
improvements: 实现资金管理模块，支持基于风险百分比和止损距离的动态仓位计算
在OnDeinit中取消注释IndicatorRelease调用，修复指标句柄资源泄漏问题
添加止盈选项或基于ATR的动态止盈，补充追踪止损的不足
将Breakeven和ProfitLock参数改为input并完成测试验证
improvements_en: Implement money management module supporting dynamic lot sizing based on risk percentage and stop loss distance
Uncomment IndicatorRelease calls in OnDeinit to fix indicator handle resource leaks
Add take profit option or ATR-based dynamic take profit to complement trailing stop
Convert Breakeven and ProfitLock to input parameters and complete testing validation

risk_points: 资金管理未实现，固定手数无法根据账户风险动态调整
异步交易模式缺乏完整错误处理和重试机制
无止盈目标，极端行情下追踪止损可能滑点严重
指标资源未正确释放可能导致长期运行内存泄漏
risk_points_en: Money management unimplemented, fixed lots cannot dynamically adjust based on account risk
Async trading mode lacks complete error handling and retry mechanisms
No take profit target, trailing stop may suffer severe slippage in extreme market conditions
Indicator resources not properly released may cause memory leaks during long-term operation
